title: Sacred Echoes of the Great Rift
narrative: A curated monographic journey exploring the raw geological and cultural cradle of the Rift Valley and the Great Lakes basin. Hand-ground mineral ochres, volcanic basalt, salvaged indigenous hardwoods, and wild terracotta clays converge to excavate the quiet majesty of our primordial home.

title: The Whispering Stone Monographs
narrative: Sculptural monuments of stillness carved from ancient Italian Carrara marble, volcanic basalt stone, and lost-wax bronze. Each work is an architectural sanctuary designed to bring meditative gravity and quiet contemplation to monumental spaces.

title: Illuminated Pigments & Ancient Folios
theme: Sacred Light, Gold Leaf & Archival Fiber
narrative: Evoking the precious illuminated manuscripts and monastic codices of antiquity, this collection pairs hand-beaten 24-karat gold leaf with raw lime plaster reliefs and hand-woven Belgian flax linen.
